name: SSH
description: Connect to your servers through this mini VM's exit with the SSH keys on your Mac. The keys never enter the VM. OpenSSH comes from Debian.
changelog: First release: OpenSSH from Debian, updated by Debian, using your Mac's ssh-agent after V2Mac asks.
securityNotes: ssh-agent lets this app ask your Mac to sign with your keys while it is open and after you allow it; the keys stay on the Mac. Agent forwarding to servers is turned off.
